description: Figure 8 presents a pie chart illustrating the composition of time cost related to deployment methods, and the reduction achieved through efficient deployment. The chart consists of two slices: “Efficient deployment” and “Reduction”. The “Efficient deployment” slice is colored blue and represents approximately 30.08% of the total. The “Reduction” slice is colored orange and represents approximately 69.92% of the total. The chart includes percentage labels displayed inside each slice. The slices are not visually emphasized or offset in any way, and appear ordered from largest to smallest proportion.
